Professional Summary
Azure-focused DevOps engineer with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and containerized platforms on Microsoft Azure. Skilled at automating deployments, improving reliability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.

Technical Skills
Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Docker, PowerShell, Linux, Agile

Work Experience

Azure DevOps Engineer, UrbanPantry (Apr 2026 - Present)
- Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to deploy microservices, reducing deployment time by 40% using Azure DevOps and Docker.
- Implemented Terraform modules to provision Azure networking, AKS clusters, and storage accounts, enabling repeatable environment creation across dev/stage/prod.
- Automated container build and image promotion workflows with Docker and Azure DevOps, integrating PowerShell scripts for release gating and health checks.

Azure DevOps Engineer, PhonePe (Mar 2022 - Mar 2026)
- Designed and operated Kubernetes clusters on Azure (AKS) for high-traffic payment services, improving pod density and reducing resource costs through optimized manifests and horizontal pod autoscaling.
- Implemented infrastructure-as-code using Terraform to manage VNet, AKS, and associated Azure resources, enabling consistent multi-environment deployments.
- Created end-to-end Azure DevOps pipelines with Docker-based build stages and PowerShell automation to accelerate release cadence and enforce compliance checks.
- Collaborated in Agile teams to introduce GitOps patterns and enhance CI feedback loops, improving deployment success rates and rollback capabilities.
